---
title: "Ion mass calculator"
toc: false
---

Calculate ion properties from a chemical formula and charge, running entirely in your browser via WebAssembly ([MassSpecToolkit](https://github.com/H3Jones/MassSpecToolkit)).

```{=html}
<form id="formula-form" class="d-flex flex-wrap gap-2 align-items-center">
  <label for="formula">Chemical formula</label>
  <input id="formula" name="formula" class="form-control w-auto" value="C6H12O6" required />
  <label for="charge">Charge</label>
  <input id="charge" name="charge" class="form-control w-auto" type="number" min="-255" max="255" step="1" value="1" required />
  <button id="calculate" type="submit" class="btn btn-primary" disabled>Calculate</button>
</form>
<pre id="result" class="mt-3" aria-live="polite">Loading WebAssembly…</pre>

<script type="module">
  import init, { evaluate_ion } from "./ms-wasm/ms_wasm.js";

  const form = document.querySelector("#formula-form");
  const formulaInput = document.querySelector("#formula");
  const chargeInput = document.querySelector("#charge");
  const calculateButton = document.querySelector("#calculate");
  const result = document.querySelector("#result");

  try {
    await init();
    calculateButton.disabled = false;
    result.textContent = "Enter a formula and select Calculate.";
  } catch (error) {
    result.textContent = `Unable to load the WebAssembly module: ${String(error)}`;
  }

  form.addEventListener("submit", (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    try {
      result.textContent = JSON.stringify(
        evaluate_ion(formulaInput.value, chargeInput.valueAsNumber),
        null,
        2,
      );
    } catch (error) {
      result.textContent = `Could not evaluate ion: ${String(error)}`;
    }
  });
</script>
```
